prompts.motion: Use the provided start image as the first frame and the provided end image as the final frame anchor. A shimmering wipe sweeps across the frame from left to right. Everything it passes is redrawn as a hand-drawn anime frame with ink outlines and cel shading, the background turning painterly. The person blinks and smiles as their hair catches a breeze with stylised anime motion. Audio: A sparkling swoosh and a short upbeat anime-style musical sting.
